item.title: Vanessa Williams Says Two Music Legends Passed on ‘Save the Best for Last’ Before It Came Her Way: ‘I Was Third One Up’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's episode of Trending on Billboard! I've got a fascinating story to share with you about the iconic singer and actress, Vanessa Williams. You might know her from her hit song 'Save the Best for Last', but did you know that it almost didn't end up in her hands?"
[Music transitions to a soft pop ballad]
Host: "Vanessa Williams recently shared on Jesse Tyler Ferguson's podcast, Dinner's on Me, that she was actually the third artist to be offered 'Save the Best for Last'. The song was initially sent to Bette Midler, who passed, and then to Barbra Streisand, who also declined. Can you imagine if it had been recorded by either of those legendary voices?"
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "But Vanessa Williams did end up recording it, and it became a massive hit, spending five weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 chart. It was released in 1991 as part of her album 'The Comfort Zone', and earned her two Grammy nominations. It's still one of her signature songs today."
[Music transitions to a quick clip of "Baby Baby" by Amy Grant]
Host: "Interestingly, Vanessa also shared that she wishes she had recorded another big hit of the time, Amy Grant's 'Baby Baby'. She said it was never brought to her attention, but she would have loved to have given it a try."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "Vanessa Williams has had an incredible music and acting career, with hits like 'The Comfort Zone', 'Colors of the Wind', and roles in Desperate Housewives and Ugly Betty. It's amazing to think about what could have been, but we're glad that 'Save the Best for Last' ended up in her talented hands."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this week's episode of Trending on Billboard! If you want to hear more about Vanessa Williams' story, check out her full interview on Jesse Tyler Ferguson's podcast, Dinner's on Me."
